warnings: The building is ใต้ถุนโล่ง (open ground floor): the foundation plan draws no ground-beam grid at all. The only beam on it is 'GB', a double line on grid 5 from column B5 down to the stair-foot column C'5 (F3/C2), under the stair start. Span = B to C' = 3.60, printed on this sheet.
No section for GB was found on S-05, S-06 or S-07 (the beam sections there are B1-B6', RB1, RB2) — the mark has no spec in this set.
